semantics: Use only for genuinely tabular row-column relationships.
When firstColumnIsRowHeader is true, first cells use th scope=row.
accessibility: Scrollable wrapper is a labelled region and keyboard-focusable.
Provide a specific ariaLabel describing the table.
constraints: Row cell counts must match the number of columns.
Do not use table markup solely for visual alignment.
Horizontal overflow may occur inside the table region, but must not create document-level overflow.
verification: Verify every row has the same cell count as columns.
Verify table region can receive focus.
Verify show more/show less when initialVisibleRows is used.
Verify no document-level horizontal overflow at 390px.
Run TypeScript and design-system registry validation.
responsive: Check 1440px, 768px, and 390px; no document overflow. Consumer-specific layout remains local.
use_when: Structured comparative data is genuinely tabular
The table may need horizontal overflow on narrow viewports
Rows may optionally be progressively disclosed
do_not_use_when: The information is better represented as cards or prose
The visual layout only resembles a table but has no row-column semantics
